scripts.name: Ultimate Reserve
scripts.description: Calculates total ultimate reserve using 180 monthly cashflow pattern weights
scripts.sql:
SELECT SUM(paid_amount * cf.RATE) AS ultimate_reserve
FROM claims_data c
JOIN &cf_pattern. cf ON cf.RUN_ID = '&run_id.' AND cf.SCENARIO = '&scenario_name.'
WHERE c.valuation_date = TO_DATE('&report_date.', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

scripts.name: IBNR Calculation
scripts.description: Calculates Incurred But Not Reported reserves with tail factor
scripts.sql:
SELECT SUM(reserve_amount * cf.RATE * &tail_factor.) AS ibnr
FROM reserves_data r
JOIN &cf_pattern. cf ON cf.RUN_ID = '&run_id.' AND cf.SCENARIO = '&scenario_name.'
WHERE r.valuation_date = TO_DATE('&report_date.', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

scripts.name: Discounted Cashflow
scripts.description: Calculates present value of future cashflows using monthly discount
scripts.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount * cf.RATE / POWER(1 + &discount_rate./12, cf.PERIOD)) AS pv_cashflow
FROM cashflow_data c
JOIN &cf_pattern. cf ON cf.RUN_ID = '&run_id.' AND cf.SCENARIO = '&scenario_name.' AND cf.PERIOD = c.month_num
WHERE c.valuation_date = TO_DATE('&report_date.', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

scripts.name: Weighted Duration
scripts.description: Calculates weighted average duration of cashflows in months
scripts.sql:
SELECT SUM(cf.PERIOD * cf.RATE) / SUM(cf.RATE) AS weighted_duration
FROM &cf_pattern. cf
WHERE cf.RUN_ID = '&run_id.' AND cf.SCENARIO = '&scenario_name.'
